primer: XLV gives low-cost (0.08%) access to 61 profitable S&P 500 healthcare leaders ($46.57B AUM, 1.44% yield). It earns COMPOUNDER_PASS quality with PASS_WITH_WATCH KPI health, though 60.64% top-10 weight, 40 IRA drugs, and Keytruda's 2028 cliff warrant caution. At $177.24 (Nov 20 close; $179.09 Nov 23 live snapshot), XLV holds Stage 2 support inside $175.46–$180.80. Because US breadth sits at 38.8% >50DMA with 10 distribution days and cash is 9.13%, we rate XLV WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT (TIER_2, $164.19 stop, $206.00 target) while NOT_HELD and declining LEAPS options, keeping 100% of marginal capital in Cash.
